description: This file declares the GstDispatcherThread class and its factory, which are responsible for handling GStreamer bus messages in a dedicated thread within the Rialto media server component. It includes class definitions, member variables, and method declarations related to GStreamer event handling and thread management.

classes.name: GstDispatcherThread
classes.description: Implements a thread to handle GStreamer bus messages asynchronously, managing the lifecycle and event processing for a GStreamer pipeline.

classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of GstDispatcherThread.
